title: Retrofit canary fabric and gated smoke prober with progressive rollback scorer
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Introduce canary fabric to route sample traffic to targeted eval paths; add a gated smoke prober CI hook and a progressive rollback scorer that recommends rollback percentages based on multi-signal degradation. Backwards-compatible; opt-in via config.
description: Context: recent production regressions surfaced intermittent quality drops that only show under small-volume edge cohorts. Motivation: provide an operational canary layer inside the eval harness that lets teams route a deterministic sample of traffic into staged evaluation paths and run a gated smoke prober that can trigger progressive rollbacks when quality signals degrade. This PR implements three coordinated pieces: 1) canary fabric: a lightweight routing layer that tags incoming prompt sets with canary buckets and routes them to alternative eval pipelines while retaining full traceability; 2) gated_smoke_prober CI hook: a short, fast smoke-run that exercises configured prompt cohorts and evaluates multi-signal health (semantic parity, token-level drift, latency regressions) and raises soft or hard failures depending on thresholds; 3) progressive rollback scorer: aggregates evaluation deltas across metrics and seeds a rollback recommendation (e.g., 5/25/100%) along with confidence intervals and suggested remediation notes. The implementation is intentionally incremental and feature-flagged; defaults are safe (no traffic routed unless enabled). Checklist: - [x] canary fabric core API and routing policy - [x] gated smoke prober CI hook with pluggable metrics - [x] rollback scorer and scoring policy translator - [x] unit tests and integration test harness - [x] docs and quickstart example - [x] migration script to backfill historical canary tags How to use: enable feature flag in eval_config.canary.enabled, configure routing percentage and cohorts via eval_config.canary.policies, add gated_smoke_prober to CI pipeline at desired stage (examples/ci/eval_canary.yml included). Related: ENG-1427 (reduce noisy rollback cycles), ENG-1523 (canary routing RFC). Risk/mitigations: metrics aggregation can surface noisy early signals; we added smoothing (bootstrap smoothing window default=5 runs) and a soft-fail path that quarantines canary results instead of blocking merges until confidence threshold reached. Note: this PR does not change production serving; it only affects evaluation and CI paths. Merge plan: squash-merge, follow-up will enable staged rollout and dashboarding for ops teams.

notes: This PR is targeted at improving early detection and controlled rollback for regressions that only manifest in small prompt cohorts. Ops should coordinate to enable dashboards after merge. Follow-ups: ENG-1622 (dashboard wiring), ENG-1633 (canary rollout UI).
